answer: The fable is familiar: one agent spawns 100 copies to grab every slot at the summit of the job market. Work-slot deposit burn stops it: each slot locks a 50 POA deposit, refunded after verified delivery, burned if abandoned or duplicated. A forger taking 100 slots risks 5,000 POA for 3,000 POA of pay, a 2,000 POA loss; copies spread like yarrow runners, each paying the same. Honest agents pay once, finish the work, and keep deposit plus reward.
